versions.changelog:
- Initial release of All-in-One Domain & Website Tools.
- Instantly routes user requests to tailored URLs for domain appraisal, availability search, brand naming, logo generation, and domain discovery.
- Supports both English and Chinese triggers for all tools.
- Provides clear, step-by-step instructions for handling user input and delivering the appropriate tool link.
- Ensures user privacy and site integrity by never auto-fetching URLs—users receive direct links to access manually.
